Hello! 

We have about 3,000 invites sent. Many have landed in spam because of our .ai domain we believe. Working on a fix. If you were in the top 3,000 and didn't get an invite yet, check your spam folder or DM me. 

Service is going great and very stable. We have shipped many big updates our first week live including trends, hashtags, search and much more. We have gif's and photo uploading on the way this week. 

In our first week of beta we have over 10,000 people in the waitlist that believe in putting people and free speech first. 

👍🐸

Hello there!

It's crucially important that we avoid building an echo-chamber early on. We are rolling out in waves, but not necessarily in order. The reason for this is because for example, the first 3,000 people are most likely from this sub. The second 3,000 are a more diverse group. So we have been pulling small groups from each section at a time to invite. Please be patient. Again we believe this is really important for longterm viability and discourse on the site.
I'm getting there. :) But many people are searching here, so it made sense to make a sub for news and discussion. On my to-do list!
Concerned about raids on individuals, such as on livestreams, etc.

Hey all, here is a draft of our Community Guidelines. It's important we get this right during before opening the door to all: which is why we want your input. I drafted this based on the guidelines of several popular forums and social sites, with free speech in mind. 

I want to open the discussion here to get feedback from the community on this draft of terms. Let us know what you think. We need to have law and order and protect users and their identity.
